Class StartingBlock

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.offerpath.StartingBlock
public class StartingBlock extends Object
Represents a single block on the starting tile where players are placed. Each block determines the player's position in the turn order for the upcoming round and applies specific modifiers (food or prestige) immediately upon placement.

  • Constructor Details

    • StartingBlock

      public StartingBlock(int position, int foodModifier, int prestigeModifier, Player occupiedBy)
      Initializes a new starting block with its designated position and modifiers.
      Parameters:
      position - The turn order position of this block (e.g., 1 for first player).
      foodModifier - The amount of food gained (positive) or required to be paid (negative) immediately upon occupying this block.
      prestigeModifier - The prestige penalty applied if the player cannot pay a negative food modifier.
      occupiedBy - The player initially assigned to this block (usually null at creation).

      public int getPosition()

    • resolveEffect

      public void resolveEffect()
      Resolves the immediate effect of occupying this starting block. Depending on the block's modifiers, the player either gains food, pays a food cost, or suffers a prestige penalty if they cannot afford the required food cost.
